lead.headline: Achane's knee 'not very optimistic'; Jefferson ruled out
lead.deck: Three starters hurt mid-game, a 0-3 start, and a lineup that was right.
lead.body: Miami's coach said after the game that De'Von Achane's knee injury 'does not sound very optimistic', with an MRI on Monday. Justin Jefferson was ruled out in the third quarter with a right ankle injury, and Jalen Coker left with a quad he says is minor. AVIATO finished on 103.8 against Footballers' 119.7 with Stafford still to play. The lineup as set was the projection lineup; the losses came from injuries. Tuten is first in line for Achane's slot, McLaurin for a receiver's.
